recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future support for EpisodeOfCare or broader encounter/context semantics on AllergyIntolerance should be handled as a new Patient Care decision rather than as unfinished FHIR-14566 work.
issue_request: FHIR-14566 was a Published Patient Care change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, that asked to link AllergyIntolerance to the encounter where the allergy or intolerance was asserted. The final resolution narrowed the original context Reference(EpisodeOfCare | Encounter) request to AllergyIntolerance.encounter 0..1 Reference(Encounter) defined as: The encounter when the allergy or intolerance was asserted.
initial_application: The combined branch had no prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-14566. Legacy commit d1b4ab658f31e533bcd58f74a4057b21772d36f8, '#14566 Add AllergyIntolerance.encounter', added the GF#14566 row to the old AllergyIntolerance spreadsheet source. Later source rework commits 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 and c69d71aa213de86d55e0261339c15e4bacd509e6 preserved the element in the current StructureDefinition source.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini as a Patient Care resource. The linked Zulip thread records the original use case, the Patient Care approval for GF#14566, and the W5-based reason for keeping encounter between patient and onset. Later FHIR-19511 workflow context-to-encounter work did not reverse FHIR-14566; it handled other Patient Care resources and treated AllergyIntolerance as outside that context-element rename set. Confluence searches found no additional or conflicting minutes.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source already has AllergyIntolerance.encounter with cardinality 0..1, type Reference to Encounter, definition 'The encounter when the allergy or intolerance was asserted.', and committee note GF#14566, so adding EpisodeOfCare or reverting to a context-named element would be contrary to the final resolution.

related_jiras.note: AdverseEvent encounter/context issue approved in the same Zulip and Patient Care discussion; it concerns a separate resource and was not decided here.
Later Patient Care workflow context-to-encounter work for other resources; useful context because it did not reverse or broaden AllergyIntolerance.encounter.
